definition.title: Complete a commitment
definition.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.
Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion.

expressionLanguage.literals: Finite scalar or homogeneous scalar-array data; no executable code.

operators.add: At least two compatible numbers -> number
operators.mul: Two numbers with at most one dimensional operand -> number; count is a multiplicity
operators.lookup: Complete primary-key binding in a typed input table -> exactly one selected scalar; missing or ambiguous lookup is invalid
operators.exists: Typed equality bindings plus optional row-scoped predicate -> boolean; no match is false
operators.interval-covered: Typed selected calendar rows and a positive half-open interval -> boolean; adjacent coverage may combine
operators.worst-case: Numeric expression -> maximum across admitted scenarios for preference only; nested or unreduced scenario aggregates are invalid

caseDerivation: All case parameters and keyed input rows use the frozen module.inputs types, units, bounds, keys and references; no missing-value defaults or coercion are inferred.
Finite choices draw only from input arrays, input table columns or fixed literal domains; the same assignment applies to every scenario.
The scenarioDomain table explicitly lists admitted joint scenarios; an empty table is an inconsistent basis rather than vacuous feasibility.
Activity graphs, constraints, mandatory obligations, resource mappings, financial mode and preference remain frozen module declarations.
Provenance describes accepted factual sources; identifying a source does not authenticate it or infer readiness.
schema.description: Installed closed typed declaration and case-admission validators; this descriptor is not a complete JSON Schema. Publication checks admission, not computed feasibility.

module.title: Review a street-team deployment
module.question: Which complete street-team deployments fit tonight’s staffing, timing, access and spending requirements?
module.description: Compare complete static deployments for one fictional venue and event. All passing options remain visible; Sam makes the choice. Customer response and additional guest thresholds do not establish marketing effectiveness.

units.timeOrigin: 00:00 on the recorded operating date; one same-day local clock

assumptions: All names, records, event details, quantities and financial amounts are fictional teaching inputs.
One complete deployment is fixed before departure. The options are mutually exclusive; no split teams, staggered shifts, adaptive interventions or additional promotions are generated.

Every staff member counted is qualified for the simplified inside work, and remains available throughout the entire declared promotion absence. Individual stations, breaks, travel staffing and unrelated bookings require a richer module.
The reviewed available count is qualified staff minus unavailable staff. The minimum inside count applies throughout the whole absence, not only at dispatch.

Each option quote is its complete future incremental cash expense. Sunk and already committed costs are excluded. Separate existing-customer discount loss is an economic consequence, not an additional cash deployment charge.

Access and spending registries are stipulated complete. Missing, false, expired, differently scoped or unsourced records confer no permission. Sam’s final choice and specific deployment authorization are recorded separately by the workflow.
All timing uses one same-day minute origin. Event exit and the customer journey are conditional planning declarations, not actual attendance or evidence that any guest accepted an offer.

No forecast of genuinely additional guests, probability of response, expected profit or profit-maximizing ranking is supplied. Hold is an available baseline and is not declared best because it costs nothing.

requirements.label: Inside staffing
requirements.meaning: Retain enough qualified staff for the complete absence.

requirements.label: Complete deployment
requirements.meaning: Preserve the authored finite complete option structures.

requirements.label: Recorded access and delegated spending
requirements.meaning: Require the exact current operating permissions.

requirements.label: Useful contact and arrival
requirements.meaning: Allow review, dispatch, contact, return and useful conditional customer arrival.

requirements.label: Incremental spending ceiling
requirements.meaning: Keep the complete future deployment charge within the recorded limit.

labels.constraint.published-option-structure: Use one of the four complete deployment structures
labels.constraint.staffing-coverage: Keep the required qualified staffing inside throughout the absence
labels.constraint.staffing-register: Do not mark more qualified staff unavailable than are recorded
labels.constraint.event-access: Have current recorded access for this event, date and promotion window
labels.constraint.spending-permission: Have a sourced spending delegation covering Sam, this evening and the complete charge
labels.constraint.dispatch-timing: Allow review, dispatch and the declared promotion start in that order
labels.constraint.contact-window: Reach event departures before the useful contact window closes
labels.constraint.useful-arrival: Leave enough journey time for interested additional guests to arrive usefully
labels.constraint.staff-return: Keep the staff absence covered through the contact window
labels.constraint.expense-limit: Keep the complete incremental deployment expense within the limit

questions.label: Qualified staffing and evening scope
questions.question: Who remains available inside if we send the team?
questions.meaning: Same venue, event and operating date. Count only staff qualified and available throughout the complete absence; unavailable staff are subtracted once.

questions.label: Useful promotion window
questions.question: Can we reach departing event guests while arrival is still useful?
questions.meaning: Same-day local minutes from midnight. Journey time is conditional on acceptance, not a customer-response forecast.

questions.label: Recorded event access
questions.question: Do current event records permit this activity for the whole contact window?
questions.meaning: Exact venue, event, date, street-promotion activity, sourced grant and validity interval. An empty register grants no access.

questions.label: Deployment charges and spending delegation
questions.question: What future expense and recorded spending delegation apply tonight?
questions.meaning: USD cents. Complete incremental expense comes from the operating option quotes; the limit and delegated permission are separate from Sam’s final specific authorization.

questions.label: Contribution per genuinely additional guest
questions.question: What contribution would one genuinely additional guest retain under each offer?
questions.meaning: USD cents after the offer and variable costs. Unknown remains unknown; zero and negative contribution cannot recover a positive expense. Attributed visits need not be incremental.

questions.label: Separate existing-customer discount loss
questions.question: Would an offer reduce contribution from guests who would have come anyway?
questions.meaning: USD cents of additional loss not already included in incremental guest contribution or deployment expense; do not double count. Unknown leaves the economic threshold unassessed.

questions.label: Sam’s explicit deployment choice
questions.question: Which passing deployment does Sam choose on this accepted assessment?
questions.meaning: Record exact accepted assessment run hash and evaluation reference, venue, date, deployment and manager. Selecting a row in a report does not make this decision.

questions.label: Specific deployment authorization
questions.question: Has Sam authorized this chosen deployment, amount and operating window?
questions.meaning: Record the same current assessment basis, venue, date and selected deployment with a sourced authorization, amount cap and validity interval. Recorded assertions do not authenticate Sam or dispatch staff.
